handback.summary: Issues labeled hotfix now build from their own text, get code review and the merge gate, with no plan.

criteria.863.1: `agent.yml` reads the hotfix label before the pack and starts the branch from main; `pack` in `dokima/agent_roles.py` builds a hotfix pack with no plan.
criteria.863.2: `start_first` and `start_unblocked` in `dokima/agent_autopilot.py` start a never-started hotfix's worker, with its own Autopilot line, instead of its planner.
criteria.863.3: `dokima/hotfix.py` writes the issue's text to `ask.md`; `agent.yml` points the prompt to it and keeps the worker's hotfix section.
criteria.863.4: `dokima/fence.py` takes `-` for a hotfix and keeps every change; `agent.yml` passes it.
criteria.863.5: The worker's hand-back is checked with `-` for the plan, so it passes, pushes, opens the draft pull request and starts code review.
criteria.863.6: The pr-stage pack holds `ask.md`, the diff and the worker's log; `problems_pack` takes `ask.md` in place of `plan.json`.
criteria.863.7: `dokima/checks.py` gives a never-planned hotfix one all-tests check; the review passes its check, so the usual merge gate runs.
criteria.863.8: A hotfix review's blocker for the planner starts the planner; once a planner ran, the issue follows the normal flow.
criteria.863.9: `back_to_planning` in `dokima/hotfix.py` comments the reviewer's blockers on the issue, called from `agent next`.
criteria.863.10: The hotfix sections in `worker.md` and `reviewer.md` name nothing of Dokima's repo; `dokima.hotfix prompt` drops them from other runs.

raises.label: Switch comment says planning
raises.text: After autopilot start, the switch comment says planning started even when a hotfix's worker started instead.

raises.label: Rules omit hotfix lane
raises.text: The flow rules and commands rules never describe the hotfix lane, so owners cannot read how it works.
raises.evidence: `rules/flow.md` and `rules/commands.md` hold no mention of hotfix.
